t: You're on Great Portland Street, a busy commercial road in the West End that runs from Oxford Street up to the Marylebone Road. It's a mix of homes and businesses, and it marks the line between Fitzrovia and Marylebone. To the west, you get grand Portland Place and Harley Street; to the east, more artists and independent businesses. The street takes its name from William Cavendish-Bentinck, the 3rd Duke of Portland, who was prime minister twice, with a gap of 23 years between his terms, the longest of any British prime minister.
